new.title: Start here: your first hours
new.intro: You'll need: the base game. About two hours gets you to the second boss. Each line links to the card or page it came from.

steps.t: Pick a class on the character screen. If you are unsure, pick [[Knight]]: its [[Knight Shield]] blocks 100% of physical damage.
Pick up the [[Ashen Estus Flask]] a short way into the first area. It refills FP; the normal [[Estus Flask]] refills HP.
Pull the [[Coiled Sword]] out of [[Iudex Gundyr]] to start the first boss fight. Hit him while he stands up: he cannot fight back until he picks up his weapon.
Thrust the [[Coiled Sword]] into the bonfire in [[Firelink Shrine]]. You can now travel between every bonfire you have lit.
Talk to the [[Fire Keeper]] at the shrine bonfire to spend souls on levels.
Take every [[Estus Shard]] and [[Undead Bone Shard]] you find back to the shrine. See How to get more Estus.
Give every Umbral Ash you find to the [[Shrine Handmaid]]. Each one adds items to her shop.
Follow the Area order page from [[High Wall of Lothric]] onward. It lists the bosses, the bonfires and the NPCs you can lose in each area.

new.check: You are on track when the shrine bonfire lets you travel and the Handmaid sells more than her first stock.

back.title: Coming back after a break
back.intro: Read this before you load an old save. It takes about five minutes.

steps.t: Open your inventory and write down which Cinders of a Lord you already hold. The Area order page shows which boss gives each one.
Check your stats against the soft caps table on the Builds page. Points past a soft cap give much less.

If your stats are spread too thin, talk to [[Rosaria, Mother of Rebirth]] in her bed chamber in [[Cathedral of the Deep]] and choose rebirth to reallocate them. Each rebirth costs one [[Pale Tongue]]; you can do it up to five times per playthrough.
Visit [[Blacksmith Andre]] and spend your titanite on one weapon. Use the How to upgrade a weapon steps.
Read the NPC quests page for every character you have already met. Several quests end for good if you go to the wrong area first.
If you want the DLCs, read the DLC order page: [[Painted World of Ariandel]] is entered from the Cleansing Chapel bonfire in [[Cathedral of the Deep]].
Practise against the next boss with its card open: each boss card has its weaknesses, its HP and the wiki strategy.

back.check: You are ready when one weapon is upgraded, your main stat is at or below its soft cap and you know your next boss.
